shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin holds above $63,000 and Ethereum briefly reclaimed $1,900 despite overall weak market sentiment.
PUMP and HYPE tokens are outperforming the broader market with significant gains from buybacks and bullish patterns.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced $385 million in outflows last week, reversing investor sentiment.
Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting minutes on August 19 are a key macro event for future interest rate policy.
Uncertainty around the expired US-Iran ceasefire agreement is weighing on risk appetite and increasing oil prices.
